crypto_primary.expected: All clean controls must verify; tests must be non-vacuous.
Both verifiers must reject a payload whose computed hash differs from the signed hash.
A signature whose authenticated signing time is later than trusted key expiration must fail.
Identity, role, and recorded fingerprint changes must fail or be explicitly unauthenticated.
Appending to a signed case must require re-signing or explicitly invalidate/remove the signature.
Portable case-file generation must reject forbidden raw-text keys throughout the entire case, not only forensic_bundle.
All offline/installed entry points must reject the same malformed artifact even when its unsigned hash is recomputed.
Reject duplicate archive member names before any name-based reads.
No entry may be decompressed after standalone container rejection; use the already validated capped contents.
A surviving record with a non-genesis previous hash must be invalid in the public wrapper.
Serialized appends from separate instances must reload/verify the head and persist indices [0,1] with a valid chain.
Different path/content maps must have distinct framed hash preimages; length-prefix records or hash a canonical per-file manifest.
An unchanged calibration chain cannot authorize a benchmark change or calibration rollback; chain head must bind verified current tree roots.
Stored head/root must be checked or recomputed before appending; a valid loaded chain must remain valid after append.
An explicitly requested missing audit-chain file is unavailable/invalid, never a verified healthy chain.
A content hash must bind subject content_sha256 and analysis provenance, or be named/scoped as a partial presentation hash.
Return valid=false with structured errors for a non-object Trust Map dimension.
Key generation/storage must have an owner-private supported-platform implementation, not an unavailable os.fchmod call.
An invalid GeneralizedTime must be a structured failure in both verifiers, never an exception or a verified token.
ECDSA-with-SHA384 names the hash, not a mandated P-384 curve; accept the curve declared in the signer certificate when supported.
A wrong-schema, unsupported-format, non-archive payload cannot be a verified bundle even when its self-declared digest matches.
Strong requires the complete declared dimension set, each supported exactly once; an arbitrary single dimension is not a strong Trust Map.
All observations above are saved with no repository writes.

crypto_followup.expected: Reject duplicate archive names even while the original manifest signature remains valid.
Packing and offline verification must reject a case rejected by the required combined verifier.
Both verifiers must reject an undeclared one-dimension strong map even when its unsigned manifest is internally consistent.
Current generated Trust Map versions must be accepted consistently by public nested schemas and runtime verifiers.
Rates must be finite, counts nonnegative integers (not bool), and SHA-256 fingerprints hexadecimal.
